raw_market.question: 1Q Spread: Saints (-2.5)
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the NFL game between Vikings and Saints, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Saints" if the Saints outscore the Vikings by 3 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Vikings".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
